main_text.p: terra extrahitur: sed cum per separationem boni à malo præparationem recepit, tunc super perfecta & imperfecta ostendit vim suam. Habito in montib2 & in planitie: pater antequam filius: genui matrem meam, & mater mea sive pater tulit me in matrice sua, generans me, nō opus habens nutrice. Hermaphrodit2 sum utriusq; natura: super omnes fortes victor, à minimo victus: & nihil sub cælo invenitur tam pulchrum & tam perfectæ figuræ.

Nascitur mirabilis avis, quæ de suis ossibus, quæ mea ossa sunt, furnulum sibi constituit, ubi sine alis volans moriens vivificatur, & Ars Naturæ leges superans in fine transmutatur in Regem, qui sex alios in virtute infinita excedit.

page.notes: Scan is partly faint; the underlining in the text is printed emphasis or marks of a reader and is not transcribed as text. Words such as "montib<sup>2</sup>" and "Hermaphrodit<sup>2</sup>" carry superscript printed numerals; the lower part of the page below the text is blank. Some words are uncertain due to faint print, notably "furnulum" and "transmutatur".
